subsequentHeadingScan.scope: Actual scratch owner, production build, loopback only. Default complete axe rule set; no exclusions. Automatic checks are not full WCAG conformance.

repairs: Embedded Calendar, Work and Kickoff use sections within the single workspace main landmark.
Ordinary help and bulk actions are siblings of the tablist.
Scout selection and Done states keep readable tile text without applying opacity to the entire tile.
Calendar day headings follow the workspace heading at level two.
Embedded Build shows the existing season selector as a visible 48px control without duplicating it.

readinessFailure.reason: Build season selector existed in a hidden embedded page header; retaining a visible-data readiness assertion caught the inaccessible control.

workspaceRegression.scope: Calendar, single-heading journeys, scouting and workspace accessibility before the final explicit data-readiness assertions.

boundedBrowserHarness.unitScope: Two coverage-helper cases plus seven origin/environment guards
boundedBrowserHarness.execution: Two whole-file groups each start and stop a fresh Playwright-managed development server, then merge reports; planned and actual case identities must match exactly.
boundedBrowserHarness.limitations: The two-case local proof is not a completed full remote CI run.
